slides.title: A book of thank-you
slides.transcript: [warmly] Alhamdulillah, Little One. A book of thank-you, for Yusuf. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] For the small things nobody thinks to be glad about.

slides.title: Two Small Hands
slides.transcript: [warmly] Two Small Hands. <break time="0.4s" /> Ten fingers that open and close all by themselves. You did not ask for them. They came with you. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: Two Round Eyes
slides.transcript: [warmly] Two Round Eyes. <break time="0.4s" /> They find the window. They find the lamp. Best of all, they find a face looking back. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: Mama's Voice
slides.transcript: [warmly] Mama's Voice. <break time="0.4s" /> You knew it before you ever saw her. Out of every sound in the world, you turn your head for that one. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: Warm Bread
slides.transcript: [warmly] Warm Bread. <break time="0.4s" /> It comes out of the oven and the whole house knows. Somebody grew the wheat. Somebody carried it here. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: Cool Water
slides.transcript: [warmly] Cool Water. <break time="0.4s" /> Clear, and cold, and there whenever you want it. That is not a small thing anywhere in the world. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: The Rain
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Rain. <break time="0.4s" /> It taps on the glass all night and makes everything green by morning. Nobody had to ask it to come. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: A Cat Called Susu
slides.transcript: [warmly] A Cat Called Susu. <break time="0.4s" /> She was here before you were. She sleeps at the end of the bed and keeps an eye on everybody. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: A Warm Bed
slides.transcript: [warmly] A Warm Bed. <break time="0.4s" /> A roof over it, and walls around it, and people in the next room who would come if you called. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: And For You
slides.transcript: [softly] And For You. <break time="0.4s" /> Eight good things, and then one more, who is lying right here listening. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Alhamdulillah for you, Yusuf.
